definitions: A model of a human being used for displaying clothes or in medical training.
An object designed to resemble and serve as a substitute for the real thing.
A rubber or plastic teat for a baby to suck on.
A person who is perceived as being unintelligent.
In bridge, the player whose hand is laid face up on the table.
examples: The baby spat out her dummy.
He used a dummy to test the crash impact.
